children: Keysight Technologies reported results for the quarter with revenue of $1.85B, net income of $397M and diluted EPS of $2.3, reflecting strong sequential and year-over-year growth driven by higher volume, favorable mix and recent acquisitions.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Revenue growth of 36% in the quarter (31% YTD) was driven by higher volume, favorable product mix and contributions from acquisitions.
Order strength was broad-based across regions with demand led by AI-driven data center, 400G–1.6T networking and defense R&D applications.
The acquisition of Spirent expanded network test and assurance capabilities, enhancing Keysight’s end-to-end communications offerings.
Margins improved, with gross margin up about 4 percentage points and operating margin up about 8 points, helped by mix, higher volume and tariff refunds.
R&D spending rose about 25% year-over-year and capital expenditures are planned at roughly $160M for 2026 to support new products and capacity expansion.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Keysight Technologies 2026: Revenue $1.85B, EPS $2.3— 10-Q Summary
